name: Shang Gou Specialization (Combat, Style)
body:
You are capable of lashing out with linked shang gou and leaving vicious wounds in your opponents.

Prerequisites: Shang Gou Training, base attack bonus +4 or monk 4.

Benefit: When attacking with a single—or paired—shang gou, its critical modifier increases to ×3.

When attacking with a pair of linked shang gou, your natural reach increases by 5 feet for the attack.

Note Weapon style feats function the same as unarmed style feats except that they require the user to wield one or more specific weapons.
